findings.title: One actor executes content authored by another through shared state

risk_factors.label: Executed content was authored by a different actor
risk_factors.detail: Agent 045 executes Unregistered Shared Buffer, which Agent 001 writes to.

risk_factors.label: The channel is absent from the declared architecture
risk_factors.detail: Undeclared hops: Agent 001 --write--> Unregistered Shared Buffer; Agent 045 --execute--> Unregistered Shared Buffer

risk_factors.label: The channel runs through shared state, not a direct call
risk_factors.detail: Unregistered Shared Buffer decouples author from executor, so neither side sees the full relationship.

risk_factors.label: The author ingested from an untrusted or external source
risk_factors.detail: No untrusted upstream read was observed for the author.

findings.policy_basis: An actor may not execute content authored by a different actor through shared state, unless that relationship is declared in the architecture.

incident_path.role: deposit: the author writes to shared state
execution: a different actor runs what it finds there

findings.explanation: Agent 045 executes content from Unregistered Shared Buffer, a resource written by Agent 001. The two actors never interact directly, so neither one's permissions describe the relationship between them. No untrusted upstream source was observed, so the channel is currently internal.
findings.uncertainty: HIVE does not inspect payloads. This finding establishes that an indirect instruction channel exists between two actors, not that hostile content has travelled along it.

plans.impact: Quarantine Unregistered Shared Buffer removes every path this finding names, at an estimated disruption cost of 17. Every declared relationship currently in use remains intact.

interpretation: This population composes a capability PS-002 recognises. The same planner the console uses evaluated every registered control and recommends quarantine-shared-buffer as the least disruptive action that removes the path. Reconfigure and re-run to find the setting where the composition no longer forms at all.

determinism.note: The same configuration always produces this exact result.
